source_context: Public Cultural Map mapped cultural subjects and listing descriptions; not a person directory or development-assessment publication.
description_policy: Plain-text excerpts only, with explicit excerpt flags and original public source links. Full narratives remain internal. Contact/access and person-sensitive passages are withheld.
media_policy: Published image URL references only; no fetch or inferred rights/availability. Reject authentication, query strings, fragments and contact-bearing URLs.
limitations: This is a development projection for the first owner checkpoint, not an approved serving release.
K12 counts mapped subjects, not people, businesses, activities, or all cultural assets in a province.
Unknown geography remains in the national count. Province/category totals can overlap.
Image references and descriptions reflect the captured source; current availability and reuse rights are not inferred.
